text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was walking down the hallway, I 
noticed a school newspaper posted on the 
wall.
choice_data_list:
Oh, there's a manga strip too. Let's see 
here—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (*Staaaaare……*)
choice_data_list:
(I-Is it just me, or... do I feel eyes on 
me...?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ack?! Did you notice?! I-I'm so sorry 
for staring...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... that manga running in the 
paper, 'Charge! Umamusume-chan'... 
Actually, I'm the one who's serializing 
it...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As an author, I want to see raw, authentic 
reactions from readers……! So sometimes, I 
stand here and observe them……!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Someone stopped to watch! That person 
is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A new episode, huh…… Wait, what? "Enter 
the Elite Rival"?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...What is with this Umamusume...? Why 
must she constantly pick a fight with 
Umamusume-chan...? ...How insolent.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
........Mmh... Such effort behind the 
scenes... ...Even so――

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
..."Only relentless training can dispel 
the endless onslaught of anxiety"... 
......

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
............Ngh. From here on out――what is 
going to happen?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whoa... I-I did iiiiiit...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I mean... just look at her! Even 
Duramente-senpai is totally hooked on what 
happens next...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For a while now, she'd glance over 
whenever she passed by! But she barely 
gave any reaction at all...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So I introduced a character designed to 
resonate especially well with stoic 
folks... and it hit the bullseye 
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna draw, draw, and draw 
some more!
choice_data_list:
It really feels like the classic 
hot-blooded manga path.

It really feels like the classic 
hot-blooded manga path.
I'm looking forward to your next work.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna draw, draw, and draw 
some more!
choice_data_list:
It really feels like the classic 
hot-blooded manga path.

It really feels like the classic 
hot-blooded manga path.
I'm looking forward to your next work.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! That's where my entire sense of 
"fun" began, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Racing and manga are the two wheels of the 
car called "Me"! Without both, there's no 
way I can drive straight forward!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whichever it is, I will always strive for 
an entertaining story! Please look forward 
to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Manga and racing. They seem completely 
unrelated, but regardless, she feels like 
someone who's bound to spark something 
exciting.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Really?! It struck a chord with you too?! 
Yaaay~!! I'm so happy! Honestly!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm working on a manga tailored 
for Trainers too! I'll be sure to let you 
know as soon as the new chapter is ready!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then! Well, I have manga drafts 
to work on, so off I go!
